titlePath: Backlog offers execution then refinement with an assessment note when needed, and Taken offers neither
story Starts keep their reading order and visible keyboard focus at narrow and zoomed widths
noted Starts explain their offers on hover, focus and in the launch dialog
noted Starts remain visually distinct from unavailable Starts in both schemes
accepted execution without an establishing skill says Starting execution in Claude Code
accepted execution with an establishing skill says Preparing until the attempt settles
accepted refinement without an establishing skill says Starting refinement in Claude Code
a missing folder explanation stays below Start execution and focus returns to that offer
a refinement refusal describes Start refinement alone and sits below both desktop offers
a progressing startup with no worker phase names its host and workflow, and Preparing when the installed skill establishes the start
an unresolved creation names its stand-in host and displays the supplied inspection arguments
refinement tabs from the instruction through the closed disclosures to Start
the refinement options disclosure keeps its selection when collapsed
a dense refinement dialog keeps its controls reachable when narrow or zoomed
touch rotation and restricted height preserve the refinement draft and choices
Start session is opposite the direction, beside preparation help, named for the selected project and hidden with its roster
Start session stays enabled with no published work, the input while its initial read is pending or has failed
the Start session progress and direction stay readable in whole words on a phone
the refusal and direction retain their room when opened, closed and rotated by touch
Start session tabs from instruction through session choices and closed command details to Start
both workspace policies keep the automatic landing actions in view when narrow or zoomed
Start session explains unavailable choices without clipping them and keeps both actions reachable at 320 pixels and at 200% zoom
Start session names the project and host, focuses an empty instruction, and Escape and Cancel return focus without sending
an instructed Start session sends the draft, hands focus to progress, and restores the launcher after startup
Follow up defaults to waiting notes, Start sends the selected choice, and Cancel sends nothing
the notes reader selects waiting notes and describes their count
the notes reader leaves Attach unavailable when no notes wait
the notes reader explains why unreadable notes cannot be attached
a Taken card shows notes waiting and offers no story Follow up
pasting text into the instruction inserts it without attaching an image
refused images explain why, keep the draft, and leave only accepted images for Start
Cancel after attaching uploads nothing and opens an empty draft next time
Escape after attaching uploads nothing and opens an empty draft next time
a held Codex read keeps Start available and a failed read offers retry without moving instruction focus
switching host aborts the old catalog and a late Codex answer leaves Claude choices intact
switching project aborts the old catalog and its late answer leaves the current project's models intact
Claude names its default and relative effort costs, and Start submits the effort shown
changing hosts resets model and effort to each host's default, and Start sends the chosen Codex model and effort
dismissing with Cancel or Escape resets the chosen model and effort when the dialog opens again
story card execution and refinement close their dialog on dismissal and return focus without starting
Start session closes its dialog on dismissal and returns focus without starting
refinement without options tabs from instruction through launch choices to Start
Codex model changes preserve compatible effort and keep incompatible effort invalid with linked feedback
an unknown configured Codex model leaves defaults usable and Start visible at narrow and zoomed widths
Cursor refuses an effort the chosen model does not list until a listed effort is chosen
refinement entries show exactly the model and options that each launch requested
execution and ad hoc entries show the requested model and disclose effort only when recorded
the Board lists each launch with its own story or in Taken, and the sidebar names its own requested model
a story's installed refinement options appear on refinement alone
No Approach clears A, keeps C and sends only C on Start
a held initial read disables refinement and a held host reread submits no options
Cancel clears the retained choices from a refused refinement
permission refusal makes no transcription request and an explicit retry works in the same dialog
an unavailable device and an unsupported recording format make no transcription request and typed Start works in the same dialog
an over-limit recording blocks Start and Record until its review is added, and Start sends the final edit
Discard in review keeps the draft focused, and Escape in review leaves the reopened dialog empty
Cancel and Escape each abandon a held transcription and a late reply leaves the next dialog empty
Cancel stops active recording without transcribing
Escape stops active recording without transcribing
late permission after either dismissal cannot populate the next dialog
unexpected microphone track end keeps the typed draft editable without requesting transcription
a keyboard start protects the selected story, announces each transition once, and leaves the next inspection focused
a blank keyboard start presents its terminal without taking focus from another task
an instructed keyboard start leaves the terminal closed and keeps the other task focused
story starts wait for launch evidence while inspection works and an unanswered read can be rechecked
a lost acceptance stays static through an unsuccessful recheck and progresses when a later read confirms it
an uncertain attempt keeps its last answer and points Continue at the host's native check
Cursor recovery offers Recheck and Continue without another host's native-check advice
a lost acknowledgment offers only Recheck, and unanswered evidence offers Recheck launch evidence
an accepted start hands focus to its protected story and a later uncertain outcome belongs in recovery
Start execution names the story, host and command, then Escape and Cancel restore the offer without starting
Start refinement names the story, host and command, then Escape and Cancel restore the offer without starting
only execution on a project whose installed skill establishes a start names the Take and workspace
execution without an establishing skill gives no Take or workspace promise
a transcript fits when draft, separator and transcript total at most 4,000 characters
a blank edit cannot be added and keyboard shortening adds the edited transcript once
the full well-over transcript stays editable and Discard adds nothing
